name: False Religion
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid false religions and deceptive teachings that mask themselves as genuine worship but actually lead away from God's truth. Jesus cautions against false prophets who appear harmless yet are inwardly dangerous, emphasizing that not all who claim to follow Him will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only those who do the Father's will. The Old Testament also forbids seeking guidance from familiar spirits or wizards, highlighting God's call to pure worship rather than human traditions or commandments. This teaching challenges believers to discern true faith by aligning with God's revealed will rather than external appearances or man-made doctrines.
